author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: The legal audit is not a suggestion. It is a hard stop. Until the data contracts are fully automated and governed to verify valid consent records before any loyalty basket data enters the pipeline, that data is legally unusable. I will not approve any forecast job that processes these scans while the contracts are missing or broken. There is no manual workaround that satisfies the compliance team. If the contracts are not in place and tested, the data flow must remain closed. We cannot risk another breach while we are still building the system. The line is drawn at the ingestion point. No valid consent, no data. Period.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly defines a non-negotiable line at the ingestion point where data flow must remain closed without valid consent, representing a refusal to proceed under any other conditions.
